canonical_serialization.numbers: integers only in seam-native fields; canonical base-10 JSON integer form
canonical_serialization.semantic_order_rule: Only explicitly set-like arrays are sorted; referenced producer-owned ordered sequences stay behind exact ref/hash.

contract_content_sha256_rule: sha256(UTF8(canonical_json(entire contract object excluding contract_content_sha256))) under SCRV3_M6_CANONICAL_JSON_V1

currentness.historical_replay: Stale envelope remains historical audit/replay artifact if original replay closure verifies; it is not current behavioral input.
currentness.invalidation_coverage: Any relevant actor-state, ADP-016 memory/accessibility, ADP-017 epistemic/accessibility/permission, generated-person, or actor-perceived-view change MUST alter at least one bound source hash; otherwise producer integrity fails.

entry_schema.full_access_component_rule: CLAIM_ACCESSIBLE => permitted_component_refs MUST be empty; empty means exact whole canonical claim_ref only.
entry_schema.memory_rule: memory_refs are exact ADP-016 actor-memory bases consumed by ADP-017; analyst-only causal-trace memory cannot be exported.
entry_schema.partial_access_component_rule: CLAIM_PARTIALLY_ACCESSIBLE => permitted_component_refs MUST be nonempty exact canonical component/subclaim refs; only those refs are positive.
entry_schema.relationship_view_rule: actor_perceived_view_refs may contain only exact same-actor actor-perceived relationship-view refs already lawful and accessible; objective relationship truth forbidden.

field_law.actor_id: exact generated actor ID, same across all actor-bound semantic records
field_law.as_of_causal_time: exact V3 causal time of co-valid source snapshot, never wall clock
field_law.source_actor_state_hash: exact actor-state content hash at as_of
field_law.source_epistemic_state_hash: exact ADP-017 epistemic/accessibility/permission state hash at as_of
field_law.source_generated_person_record_hash: exact generated-person content hash at as_of
field_law.source_memory_state_hash: exact ADP-016 memory-state content hash consumed by ADP-017 at as_of

first_person_permission.non_widening: V2 may omit/narrow scope but may not change supplied permission class or add/join a claim.

allowed_rules: first_person_permission == DENY_FIRST_PERSON_CLAIM is also allowed for any actual ADP-017 accessibility state iff the exact permission_record_ref proves NO_GOVERNED_STANCE

raw_upstream_exclusion.audit_exception: Upstream provenance may be reachable only behind OpaqueAuditRef through an audit-only resolver/sink; its type/payload/metadata cannot enter V2 behavioral/model-visible lanes.
forbidden_in_positive_entry_or_denial_re: analyst objective relation revealing hidden truth
structural causal explanation not independently actor-acquired
raw_upstream_exclusion.metamorphic_rule: Holding positive entries, deny/defer decisions, lawful V2 inputs and render receipts fixed, changing only opaque provenance causes no behavioral semantic change.

replay_reference_closure.ReplayReceipt_if_present: audit-only inside closure; never permission/semantic input
replay_reference_closure.envelope_binding: opaque_provenance_refs MUST contain exactly one OpaqueAuditRef with audit_role ENVELOPE_REPLAY_CLOSURE_ROOT whose opaque_ref_id/hash equal closure_id/hash.

states.behavior: zero actor-safe claim semantics; no fallback
states.condition: integrity_state != VERIFIED OR any envelope/entry/decision/replay hash or actor/source/authority binding fails

states.behavior: zero actor-safe claim semantics from stale envelope; session/transcript/upstream cannot restore
states.condition: historically verified envelope at later receiver causal time has any bound source hash change

states.behavior: no first-person claim; system missing authority does not become actor uncertainty/nonknowledge
states.condition: requested claim has exact nonrenderable decision ref with DEFER_MISSING_AUTHORITY

states.behavior: no first-person claim; denial does not expose hidden claim content
states.condition: requested claim has exact nonrenderable decision ref with DENY_FIRST_PERSON_CLAIM

states.behavior: only listed component refs are positive semantic input
states.condition: requested claim has current verified entry with CLAIM_PARTIALLY_ACCESSIBLE and nonempty permitted_component_refs

states.behavior: exact canonical claim_ref is positive semantic input under supplied permission
states.condition: requested claim has current verified entry with CLAIM_ACCESSIBLE and empty permitted_component_refs

states.behavior: absence is not knowledge, nonknowledge, denial, uncertainty, or permission
states.condition: requested claim has no positive entry and no exact deny/defer decision ref

states.behavior: valid empty actor-safe handoff; no actor claim may be fabricated
states.condition: envelope current+verified and allowed_claim_entries is empty
